titles.notes: Source of title: Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977.
titles.title: Blue and White Abstraction

description: A bird-like shape with dark blue wings flies along an arched, dark blue line. Above the bird form is a pale blue sky, and beneath it is a curved, darker blue shape that fills the bottom right corner of the canvas.
title: Blue and White Abstraction
